lines.text: After Solomon finished building the temple and the palace, the LORD appeared to him a second time, as at Gibeon.
The LORD said He had heard Solomon's prayer and consecrated the temple by putting His Name there forever.
If Solomon walked as Moses did, doing all God commanded and keeping His ordinances, his throne would last forever.
If they turned away, broke His commandments, and served and worshiped other gods, Israel would be cut off and envied.
Passersby would ask why the LORD did this; the answer: Israel forsook Him, who brought their fathers out of Egypt.
